name: pr-radar
description: Finds open-source issues where an outside PR is likely to get merged, explains why, and pings your phone.

paragraphs: Finds open-source issues where an outside PR is likely to get merged, explains why, and pings your phone.
features: Collector (collector/, Python 3.12 + uv): GitHub Search + GraphQL, Hacker News (Algolia), release feeds, optional github.com/trending scrape. Runs every 30 minutes on GitHub Actions.
Score v1: a transparent weighted formula over repo health signals, with the reasons stored next to every score.
Website (web/, Next.js 16 + Tailwind 4 + Motion): radar overview, ranked opportunities with feedback buttons, trending repos, signals feed, repo detail, model lab. Command palette on Ctrl/⌘ K or /.

Public Telegram bot: anyone can open the bot and send /start. Each subscriber picks a minimum score (/min 80), languages (/lang python rust), and turns alerts or the 08:00 IST digest on or off; /top shows the best picks…
ML (collector/ml/): LightGBM merge-probability model trained on the public ClickHouse githubevents dataset, compared against score v1 on a time split. It replaces v1 only if it wins clearly.

whatItDoes.text: Finds open-source issues where an outside PR is likely to get merged, explains why, and pings your phone.
